[[Rei Ami]] | Performers | "Prologue (Hunter's Mantra)" and "[[Golden (Huntrix song)|Golden]]" from ''[[KPop Demon Hunters]]'' |} ==Ceremony information== [[File:Conan O'Brien at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival 03 (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|[[Conan O'Brien]] hosted the 98th Academy Awards.|alt=Photo of Conan O'Brien in January 2025.]] In March 2025, the Academy hired television producers Raj Kapoor and Katy Mullan, for the third year in a row, to oversee production of the 2026 ceremony, with comedian and former talk show host [[Conan O'Brien]] as host of the event for the second consecutive year. Jeff Ross and Mike Sweeney, long-time collaborators of O'Brien, also returned as producers for a second time; Sweeney also served as a writer.{{cite news |last1=Nolfi |first1=Joey |title=Conan O'Brien Returning as 2026 Oscars Host, 98th Academy Awards Date Set |url=https://ew.com/conan-obrien-returning-2026-oscars-date-revealed-11697987 |access-date=January 31, 2026 |work=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |date=March 17, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250430213336/https://ew.com/conan-obrien-returning-2026-oscars-date-revealed-11697987 |archive-date=April 30, 2025 |url-status=live}} "We are thrilled to bring back Conan, Raj, Katy, Jeff, and Mike for the 98th Oscars," stated AMPAS CEO [[Bill Kramer (executive)|Bill Kramer]] and then-AMPAS president [[Janet Yang]] in a press release. "[Last] year, they produced a hugely entertaining and visually stunning show that celebrated our nominees and the global film community in the most beautiful and impactful way. Conan was the perfect host — skillfully guiding us through the evening with humor, warmth and reverence. It is an honor to be working with them again."{{cite news |last1=Lincoln |first1=Ross A. |title=Conan O’Brien to Return as Oscars Host in 2026 |url=https://www.thewrap.com/conan-obrien-to-return-as-oscars-host-in-2026/ |access-date=January 31, 2026 |work=[[TheWrap]] |date=March 17, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251120015638/https://www.thewrap.com/conan-obrien-to-return-as-oscars-host-in-2026/ |archive-date=November 20, 2025 |language=en-US |url-status=live}} In response, Kapoor and Mullan stated in a press release, "We are both so honored to be returning in our roles for the 98th Oscars. The award was announced in a February 2024 press release with Academy CEO Kramer and then-AMPAS president Yang stating, "Casting directors play an essential role in filmmaking, and as the Academy evolves, we are proud to add casting to the disciplines that we recognize and celebrate."{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2024/02/motion-picture-academy-creates-casting-category-first-new-competitive-oscar-since-2001-1235819319/ |title=Motion Picture Academy Creates Casting Category, First New Competitive Oscar Since 2001 |last=Hammond |first=Pete |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=February 8, 2024 |access-date=January 22, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240208181203/https://deadline.com/2024/02/motion-picture-academy-creates-casting-category-first-new-competitive-oscar-since-2001-1235819319/ |archive-date=February 8, 2024 |url-status=live}} Nominees would be initially voted in a preliminary round to determine a shortlist consisting of ten films. Each of the shortlisted films would have its respective casting director showcase their work in a shortlist presentation utilizing written notes highlighting the process, film reel clips, and a Q&A with members of the Casting branch. The members in that branch would narrow down the roster to five nominees, and the entire membership would then vote for the winner.{{cite news |last1=Davis |first1=Clayton |title=Nobody Knows How to Win It: Inside Oscar’s Most Mysterious New Casting Category |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/columns/oscars-new-casting-category-explained-1236585195/ |access-date=February 8, 2026 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=November 20, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251230104614/https://variety.com/2025/film/columns/oscars-new-casting-category-explained-1236585195/ |archive-date=December 30, 2025 |language=en-US |url-status=live}} A category to award achievement in casting had previously been rejected by the Academy in 1999.{{cite news |last1=Geraets |first1=Nell |title=Casting directors Find the Stars We Love. Academy members could fulfill this requirement by watching the nominees on the Academy's streaming platform or uploading a ticket stub or any form of documentation stating that the member watched the film. *In accordance with recommendations by the Academy’s Science and Technology Council regarding usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence in the filmmaking process, the group determined that the tools neither helped nor harmed a film's chances for receiving a nomination. The Academy and its branches would judge each achievement "taking into account the degree to which a human was at the heart of the creative authorship when choosing which movie to award." *In the Best Picture category, films released in the first six months of the year must have shown proof of submission for [[Producers Guild of America]] (PGA) mark certification or awards-only determination by September 10, 2025; films released in the remaining months of the year must submit proof of submission for the PGA by November 13. *For Best Animated Short Film, all Academy members were invited to participate in the nominations round. *The Best Cinematography category would first have a preliminary short list featured ten to twenty films which would later be narrowed down to five nominees. *For International Feature Film, eligibility rules regarding creative control now were updated in consideration of filmmakers with refugee or asylum status.
